description: This Java class extends SafeDeleteProcessorDelegateBase to handle safe deletion of Android components within an IDE, including locating component declarations in Android manifests and managing related references.

classes.name: AndroidComponentSafeDeleteProcessor
classes.description: A processor for safely deleting Android components, handling references and manifest declarations.

methods.name: handlesElement
methods.description: Checks if the element is an Android component that can be handled for safe deletion.

methods.name: findUsages
methods.description: Finds usages of the element, filtering out the declaration in the manifest.

methods.name: getElementsToSearch
methods.description: Retrieves elements to search for references.

methods.name: getAdditionalElementsToDelete
methods.description: Gets additional elements to delete related to the main element.

methods.name: prepareForDeletion
methods.description: Prepares the element for deletion, including removing manifest declarations.

methods.name: isToSearchInComments
methods.description: Determines if comments should be searched for references.

methods.name: setToSearchInComments
methods.description: Sets whether to search in comments.

methods.name: isToSearchForTextOccurrences
methods.description: Determines if text occurrences should be searched.

methods.name: setToSearchForTextOccurrences
methods.description: Sets whether to search for text occurrences.
